summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Supply Chain Management System completed successfully. Backend API testing achieved 100% success rate (22/22 tests passed). Frontend testing confirmed all dashboard pages load correctly, authentication works, and CRUD operations are functional. Sample data loading and navigation between pages working as expected.
passed_tests: User signup flow - successfully creates account and redirects to dashboard
User login flow - authentication working with JWT tokens
Sample data seeding via Load Sample Data button
Overview Dashboard - KPIs, stock levels chart, alerts panel all functional
Dashboard navigation - all 5 pages (Overview, Inventory, Suppliers, Forecast, Orders) load correctly
Backend API endpoints - 22/22 tests passed (100% success rate)
CRUD operations - Create, Read, Update, Delete working for all entities
Dashboard stats API - returns correct inventory, supplier, and order metrics
Stock levels chart - displays data by category correctly
Alerts system - shows low stock and supplier risk alerts
Responsive design across different viewport sizes
Real-time data synchronization between frontend and backend

success_percentage.frontend: 95% - All major features working, minor session timeout interruption during extended testing
